edusuite.name: Hyperion EduSuite
edusuite.tagline: Complete school OS for private, Islamic, and public schools across Nigeria
edusuite.audience: Built for private, Islamic, and public schools anywhere in Nigeria — with strong on-ground support from Abuja.

setupFeeNgn.note: Depends on campus size, data migration, and SMS volume

subscription.note: Priced by student band; includes hosting and Hyperion Care Starter for year one when bundled

modules.title: Auth & security
modules.description: Secure login, roles, and school membership.

modules.title: Role dashboards
modules.description: KPIs and alerts for owners, teachers, parents, and students.

modules.title: Student management
modules.description: Profiles, admission, enrollment, and class allocation.

modules.title: Parent portal
modules.description: Fees, results, attendance, and messages in one place.

modules.title: Staff & HR
modules.description: Staff profiles, departments, leave, and contracts.

modules.title: Academic management
modules.description: Classes, subjects, timetable, and teacher assignment.

modules.title: Attendance
modules.description: Daily and period attendance for students and staff.

modules.title: Exams & results
modules.description: Marks entry, report cards, and parent publishing.

modules.title: Fees & accounting
modules.description: Fee structures, invoices, Paystack payments, and arrears.

modules.title: Communication
modules.description: Notices, email, and SMS announcements.

modules.title: Settings & config
modules.description: Terms, grading scales, branding, and school preferences.

modules.title: Library
modules.description: Catalogue, issue/return, and fines.

modules.title: Transport
modules.description: Routes, vehicles, drivers, and student allocation.

modules.title: Hostel
modules.description: Rooms, beds, allocation, and hostel fees.

modules.title: Inventory & assets
modules.description: Assets, stock, and assignment tracking.

modules.title: Documents & certificates
modules.description: Certificates, letters, and school documents.

modules.title: Events & calendar
modules.description: School calendar, events, and term dates.

modules.title: LMS (lite)
modules.description: Link learning materials and Hyperion courses to your school.

modules.title: Alumni
modules.description: Graduate records and alumni engagement.

modules.title: Reports & analytics
modules.description: Cross-module reports for fees, academics, and operations.

pilotSchool.rationale: Existing term-subscription relationship; strongest path to a flagship EduSuite case study.

icms.name: Hyperion ICMS
icms.tagline: Islamic Center Management System — white-label sites, prayer times, Waqf, donations, and Islamiyyah for mosques and Islamic centers
icms.audience: Built for mosques, Islamic centers, and faith-based community organisations across Nigeria — multi-tenant SaaS with custom domains and on-ground Abuja support.

setupFeeNgn.note: Depends on branding, content migration, custom domain, and Paystack donation setup

subscription.note: Priced by plan tier (Community / Growth / Institution); includes hosting and Hyperion Care Starter for year one when bundled

modules.title: White-label website
modules.description: Brand-first public site with custom domain, pages, and UI variants per center.

modules.title: Prayer times
modules.description: Location-based daily prayer timings with method and madhab settings.

modules.title: Events & programmes
modules.description: Jum’uah, lectures, and community events on the public calendar.

modules.title: Articles & khutbah
modules.description: Publish guidance, announcements, and knowledge content for the congregation.

modules.title: Facilities
modules.description: Showcase prayer halls, classrooms, and center amenities.

modules.title: Donations & Paystack
modules.description: Donate funds, ledger, and per-tenant Paystack keys for transparent giving.

modules.title: Waqf projects
modules.description: Endowment campaigns with goals, progress, and lasting-charity storytelling.

modules.title: Bank details
modules.description: Published account details and fund labels managed from admin.

modules.title: Islamiyyah
modules.description: Classes and student records for Qur’an and Islamic learning programmes.

modules.title: Leadership
modules.description: Imams, directors, and public leadership profiles.

modules.title: Shurah / committee
modules.description: Committee membership and governance roles.

modules.title: Team & roles
modules.description: Owner, imam, editor, finance, and viewer roles with capability gates.

modules.title: Brand tokens
modules.description: Colors, typography, and logo for each tenant’s white-label identity.

modules.title: Contact inbox
modules.description: Messages from the public contact form in one place.

pilotCenter.rationale: Flagship tenant showcase already on the platform — strongest path to a named ICMS case study and referrals.
